# zh lexicon — authoring review sheet (generated by content/zh/_drafts/_generators/zh-lex.py)

Hand-chosen lexicon for zh-vi: 718 A1 words and 188 A2-1 words (core-*.txt). It replaces the pool-only sheet of `scripts/lexicon-author.ts`; do not re-run that script over it.

A human still has to check:

- **Vietnamese text.** Every gloss and example translation was written by an AI agent and awaits the D-10 review. There are no `TODO:vi` markers.
- **Chinese examples.** Original sentences in simplified characters, checked by zh-lex.py for character band and length only — a native or advanced reader should read every one.
- **English glosses.** Short glosses for the build tools and the inherited zh-en pack; the zh-en words keep the pack's own glosses (`the man`, `to eat`).

## Counts

- A1 by part of speech: adjective 72, adverb 36, conjunction 8, determiner 1, expression 33, interjection 4, noun 297, other 60, preposition 8, pronoun 39, verb 160 (measure words 33, numerals 17, particles 10 inside `other`)
- HSK 3.0 anchor (ivankra/hsk30): A1 HSK1 435, A1 HSK2 194, A1 HSK3 25, A1 HSK4 15, A1 HSK5 1, A1 HSK7-9 1, A1 none 47, A2-1 HSK2 122, A2-1 HSK3 14, A2-1 HSK4 20, A2-1 HSK5 7, A2-1 HSK6 3, A2-1 HSK7-9 6, A2-1 none 16
- HSK coverage: level 1 435 of 506 words taken; level 2 333 of 767.
- Readings (CC-CEDICT, citation tones): confirmed by the HSK list 752, by the HSK list without tones 13, the only CC-CEDICT reading 101, chosen in the row among CC-CEDICT readings 31, a chain of entries 9. Traditional spelling differs from the simplified surface on 446 lexemes.
- wordfreq 3.1.1 (zh, large list): 892 of 906 lexemes are in the list; 349 in the top 1,000, 608 in the top 3,000, 813 in the top 10,000. Selection evidence only: `frequency` is not set on zh lexemes (see the plan, §8).
- Examples: 906, all original (`original-lexicon-etl`, key `add`), with Vietnamese and English translations; no Tatoeba sentence is used.
- Hán-Việt: 163 course words added to `content/hanviet/zh.json` (199 entries in all, 24 flagged as false friends); 193 lexemes have a reading there.
- Characters: 520 distinct characters in A1 surfaces (299 of the 300 HSK level-1 characters, 175 level-2, 46 beyond). Course target: 474 characters (`content/zh/_drafts/review/hanzi.json`).
- Proper nouns (never a daily new word): 9.
- zh-en (basic pack, never edited): every word is a lexeme with the pack's English gloss.

## HSK 1 words left out, by reason

**a character taught inside its compounds rather than alone at A1 (电 in 电话, 左 in 左边, 起 in 起床)** (9): 常, 电, 间, 起, 外, 右, 正, 子, 左

**a surface with two readings whose other uses the course teaches through compounds (地 dì / de, 中 zhōng / zhòng): one lexeme per surface** (2): 地, 中

**kept for after A1: rare at work and in daily life** (6): 本子, 动作, 教学楼, 男生, 女生, 学院

**a phrase of taught words, met in their examples and lessons (楼上 = 楼 + 上, 看到 = 看 + 到)** (31): 半年, 北边, 不大, 车上, 打球, 得到, 地上, 东边, 干什么, 关上, 国外, 回到, 家里, 看到, 来到, 楼上, 楼下, 没什么, 南边, 上边, 身上, 听到, 网上, 网友, 西边, 下边, 小朋友, 小学生, 一边, 在家, 中学生

**another form or the short form of a taught word (爸 = 爸爸, 面条儿 = 面条, 有时 = 有时候, 〇 = 零)** (23): 爸, 唱, 弟, 电视机, 读书, 哥, 记, 姐, 考, 〇, 妈, 妹, 面条儿, 奶, 男孩儿, 女孩儿, 睡, 星期日, 一块儿, 一下儿, 有时, 有些, 有一些
